decision.explanation: Multiple documents assert different composers for Symphony No. 38: Joseph Haydn (C major, Hoboken I/38), Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (D major, K. 504, Prague Symphony), Michael Haydn (F major, Perger 30), and Ludwig van Beethoven (implied in a general description). These refer to distinct works with the same number, so they are not mutually exclusive but relate to different symphonies. The prior claim attributing it to Johannes Brahms is unsupported by the documents.
